body:
Glenwood Springs has hot springs, a busy interstate exit, and a town that still needs plumbers, dentists, and shops in January. Visitor searches and resident searches should not be mashed into one vague page.

I split them when the business needs both. The listing stays tied to the real location. Service-area companies say how far up and down the valley they go.

extraA: With two clear paths on the site if you truly serve both, not with a headline that tries to impress everyone. We pick primary services and name the towns. The listing description stays factual.
